sentence_stem: Last night the power went off, so
full_sentence: Last night the power went off, so we played cards by candlelight.
acceptable_variants: we lit some candles and talked.
we read books with a torch.

options.text: the lights stayed on all night.
options.why_wrong: This contradicts the stem, which says the power went off.
A big breakfast is not the natural result of a power cut at night, so the clause does not follow logically.

options.text: we watched a film on TV.
options.why_wrong: Watching TV needs electricity, so this contradicts the power cut.

grammar_focus: Past simple regular verbs (-ed endings) after 'so'
explanation: 'So' introduces a logical result of the power cut, so the completion must describe a reasonable activity without electricity. The regular past form 'played' takes the -ed ending.
translation: Zeszłej nocy zgasło światło, więc graliśmy w karty przy świecach.
